extensions.source: shared/tokens.css (custom properties on :root; dark values under :root[data-theme="dark"]). Lesson kit: shared/lesson.css. Agent rules: agent/plugin/skills/teach/STYLE-GUIDE.md.

themes.dark: applies only by explicit user choice via data-theme="dark" on <html>

display.purpose: Lesson title and New topic title; one per page.

title.purpose: Lesson subsections (h3). App top bar topic title is 20px/28px 600.

lede.purpose: Paragraph after the lesson title, Ink 2, 64ch.

ui.purpose: Controls, lists, chat, tables; tabular numerals.

secondary.purpose: Status lines, captions, meta lines, Ink 3.

label.purpose: Sentence-case group labels and list meta, Ink 3.

math.purpose: Formula blocks and inline math only.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Control lift: secondary buttons, composer, current topic row, selected theme button.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Float: toast and video play button only.

shadows.name: field-ring
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs and composer, with an accent border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one curve for presses, state changes and entrances.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Looping indeterminate bar in the video-wait state only.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Hover color, background and border changes.

motion.name: t-state
motion.purpose: State changes: feedback and hint rise, chevron and details rotation, chat message rise.

motion.name: t-enter
motion.purpose: Entrances for items that arrive while the view is open: new lesson row, toast, done card, video frame fade.

motion.name: check-draw
motion.purpose: Tick draws in once when a lesson becomes done.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Entrances become opacity fades; press scale, hatch crawl, typing dots and sliding bar stop; spinner slows to 1.6s.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.note: Rail becomes a two-row top bar; workspace becomes one scrolling column (outline toggle, lesson 78vh, tutor 70vh).

extensions.icons: One family in web/src/icons.tsx: 16px grid, 1.5 stroke, round caps and joins, currentColor, inline SVG.

components.description: Signature: one segment per lesson; done fills blue, current is a blue wash, a lesson in progress is a crawling hatch.

narrative.overview:
Stoa is the category standard for a learning tool, executed at full craft, with no metaphor and no themed world. The app is a quiet frame. The lesson in the centre column is the product, and every other surface steps back from it. The craft bar is Brilliant.org, Claude.ai and Notion: white paper, a near-black three-step ink ladder, hairline borders, and one confident blue that appears only where it means something.

The density is that of a work tool, not a marketing page. App chrome uses 14px text and 36px controls. The lesson uses 17px body text at a 68-character measure, so the learner can read for an hour. Progress, waiting and Athena's status are always visible and always specific. Waiting is calm: hatched segments, a slow spinner, a sentence about what Athena does now.

App and lessons share one token file (`shared/tokens.css`). Agent-written lesson pages get the same tokens and a lesson kit (`shared/lesson.css`), so a lesson looks like part of the app. The agent-facing rules for lesson markup live in `agent/plugin/skills/teach/STYLE-GUIDE.md`. This file does not repeat them.

Light mode is the default. Dark mode applies only when the user chooses it with the appearance switch (`data-theme="dark"` on `<html>`). Every token has a dark counterpart (see `.impeccable/design.json`).
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces, a cool off-white second layer for rails and the tutor, 1px hairlines.
One blue accent for primary actions, current selection, focus and progress only.
System font stack, a fixed rem type scale, tabular numerals everywhere in the UI.
8px radius on controls, 12px on panels and lesson blocks.
Near-flat: two small shadows, used on controls and floating items, never on content cards.
Short, purposeful motion on one ease-out curve; reduced motion falls back to fades.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue marks an action, the current place, focus, or progress. If a blue element is none of these, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Lessons and app code read colors from tokens, never hard-coded hex values, so dark mode works. The only exception is the black letterbox behind a started video.

rules.name: The Decoration Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink 4 is for dots, rings and separators. Text uses Ink 1, 2 or 3.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All labels are sentence case, with no uppercase tracking. No label or kicker sits above a heading. The lesson meta line holds facts only (lesson number, time, topic).

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: UI numerals are tabular (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`), so counts and scores do not shift.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Reading text never runs wider than 68ch.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Content blocks (callouts, exercises, code, formulas, details, the video frame) have a border or a tint, never a shadow.

dos: Do read every color, space and radius from `shared/tokens.css`; lessons follow `agent/plugin/skills/teach/STYLE-GUIDE.md`.
Do keep blue for actions, the current place, focus and progress (The One Voice Rule).
Do give every waiting state a specific sentence about what Athena does now.
Do put 8px radius on controls and 12px on panels and lesson blocks.
Do use the 160ms press scale (0.97) on buttons and the 4px rise only for items that arrive while the view is open.
Do pair every color signal with an icon or words (feedback ticks and crosses, status text).
Do keep reading text at 68ch or less.
donts: Don't add a course-catalog dashboard: card grids, streaks, badges or hero metrics.
Don't put shadows on content blocks; shadows belong to controls and floating items only.
Don't use decorative gradients or textures. The hatched "being built" segment and the video-wait bar are state signals, not decoration.
Don't add colored side stripes. A neutral left rule (Strong Hairline on blockquotes, Hairline on chat activity lines) is part of the system.
Don't place a label, kicker or eyebrow above a heading, and don't use uppercase tracked labels.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons; use the 16px stroke icon family.
Don't set fonts or a page background inside a lesson, and don't load other font files.
Don't open the app in dark mode by default.
